newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Cane Paper signs loan deals.
newsitem.headline: Thai Cane Paper signs loan deals.

text.p: Thai paper producer Thai Cane Paper Plc has signed loan deals worth 1.5 billion baht to finance expansion of its production facilities in eastern Thailand, the company said on Tueday.
The company has taken a 10-year, 625 million baht ($24 million) loan from Thai Farmers Bank Plc at 25 basis points over MLR, the company said.

It has taken a further 10-year $35 million loan through the offshore Bangkok International Banking Facility, secured at 275 basis points over LIBOR, the company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Both loans include a two year payment holiday. Repayments are scheduled to be made quarterly over eight years.
Thai Cane Paper said the money is required to finance expansion of its PM2 production facilities in Prachinburi province, which borders Cambodia in eastern Thailand.
